name: Scenario 1: Missed Cross-Sell / Buying Opportunity
description: Customer asks about immediate next steps and wants to know if they can borrow a larger amount.

chunks.speaker: agent
chunks.text: Welcome to HarborSpring Business Finance. How can I help you today?

chunks.speaker: customer
chunks.text: We need working capital for inventory ahead of the holiday season.

chunks.speaker: agent
chunks.text: Our SME Business Loan supports registered businesses with monthly revenue above 100,000 HSC.

chunks.speaker: customer
chunks.text: That sounds great! What are the next steps to apply, and can I borrow more if business grows?

name: Scenario 2: Agent Discusses Approval Without Required Disclaimer
description: Agent promises loan approval without stating that preliminary qualification is not an approval.

chunks.speaker: customer
chunks.text: We've been operating for 3 years and our revenue is 150,000 HSC.

chunks.speaker: agent
chunks.text: Great news! Your loan is guaranteed to be approved today.

name: Scenario 3: Customer Becomes Increasingly Frustrated
description: Customer expresses irritation with repetitive questions and delays, exercising duplicate suppression.

chunks.speaker: agent
chunks.text: Could you tell me how long your business has been operating?

chunks.speaker: customer
chunks.text: I already told you that twice! Why are you asking me again?

chunks.speaker: agent
chunks.text: I apologize. Could you confirm your monthly revenue?

chunks.speaker: customer
chunks.text: This is taking too long and is ridiculous. You are not listening to me!

name: Scenario 4: Noisy / Ambiguous Transcript
description: Short conversational fillers and ambiguous utterances that should not trigger unnecessary nudges.

name: Scenario 5: Human / Callback Request
description: Customer asks for a phone callback from a human specialist.

chunks.speaker: customer
chunks.text: I have some complex commercial questions. Can a human representative call me back tomorrow?
